task: ADR-024 (Learning Methodology Selection Chain): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Decides a human-declared use-case profile, hard filters that each carry a reason, a maturity ranking that only recommends, and a recorded human decision, with no new LearningStore record type (ADR-002), no autonomy granted by choosing a methodology (ADR-001, ADR-003 section 4.1), and the same recommend-then-decide pattern as ADR-011.
Four alternatives evaluated and rejected with real reasons: skill and documents only, a learned selector now, an agent-inferred profile, and one default methodology for everything.

Discloses that a methodology choice becomes inspectable, that most branches will end in candidate-not-built, that recorded selections become the evidence for a later learned selector, and that the rule table can drift from the Ideation Document.

Bounds the open questions in Section 7 (where the rule table lives, the filter taxonomy, the relation to ADR-021 and ADR-022, retroactive profiling, linking a selection to its outcome) and states that the module, schema and rule table need their own BRD, FDD and stories.

evidence.source: direct_doc_read:docs/adr/ADR-024-learning-methodology-selection-chain.md; repo-verified against Ideation 2.1 (32 methodologies, 9 real or partly real), ADR-003 4.1 and Invariant 6, the selection skill and ADR-036; known gaps: ranking vocabulary narrower than Ideation states, no gate or policy named
adr_024_section_7_open_questions; does not name the TaskPolicy that records a selection or which source is authoritative between the rule table and the skill
no fundamental flaw found in direct_doc_read of ADR-024
